definitions.gloss: comeback victory; winning after being behind
definitions.explanation: a victory achieved after overcoming a losing position

examples.japanese: {逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
9⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They won with a comeback in the bottom of the ninth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧な{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: They clinched the championship with a dramatic comeback victory.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ちする - to come from behind and win
- {逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ちを⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ - to pull off a comeback win
- ⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧な{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち - a dramatic comeback
- サヨナラ{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち - a walk-off comeback win

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け→逆転負け：16452_gyakutenmake⟧ - the opposite: losing after being ahead
- ⟦{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}→大逆転：21652_daigyakuten⟧ - a big turnaround

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{先制点|せんせいてん}→先制点：08585_senseiten⟧ - the opening score
- ⟦{同点|どうてん}→同点：08586_douten⟧ - tie score
